_comment: Registry of people, places, polities and concepts. `wiki` is the English Wikipedia title. Everything else (summary, image, coordinates, dates, Marathi name) is fetched by scripts/build_data.py.

siddi-jauhar.name: Siddi Jauhar
siddi-jauhar.description: Abyssinian-origin general of the Bijapur Sultanate, titled Salabat Khan; besieged Panhala in 1660

annaji-datto.name: Annaji Datto
annaji-datto.description: Sachiv (minister for correspondence) in Shivaji's Ashta Pradhan; executed in 1681 after a plot against Sambhaji

bahadurgad.name: Bahadurgad (Dharmaveergad)
bahadurgad.description: Fort at Pedgaon on the Bhima river, Ahmednagar district; Aurangzeb's camp in 1689

bhupalgad.name: Bhupalgad
bhupalgad.description: Hill fort in Sangli district, Maharashtra (also called Banurgad); taken by the Mughals in 1679

nizam-ali.wiki: Nizam Ali Khan, Asaf Jah II
nizam-ali.name: Nizam Ali Khan

trimbakji-dengle.name: Trimbakji Dengle
trimbakji-dengle.description: Favourite minister of Bajirao II, blamed by the British for the murder of Gangadhar Shastri (1815)

raverkhedi.name: Raverkhedi
raverkhedi.description: Village on the Narmada in Khargone district, Madhya Pradesh; Bajirao I died and was cremated here

ashti.name: Ashti
ashti.description: Village in Solapur district, Maharashtra; site of the Battle of Ashti (1818)

domingo-paes.name: Domingo Paes
domingo-paes.description: Portuguese traveller and horse trader whose eyewitness account of Vijayanagara (c. 1520–22) is a key source for Krishnadevaraya's capital
